description: The control of maximal-terminator-query-offset. The longer y sounds "ab", so y≠"ab" does not hold of it. The omission of [T] after y → A is permitted, and begins of r holds (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text W $s(suffix)
%conditions begins($s, r)
%rule suffix A B
%rule r y≠"ab" [++T] B
%rule y A | A B
